g.text: Outer gVisor Sandbox (runsc / Virtual Kernel 4.4.0)
Why Direct docker.io and Nested runsc Fail Inside Outer gVisor
Inner gvx Process (rungv Running Inside Outer gVisor)
1. modprobe overlay / br_netfilter -> FATAL: /lib/modules/4.4.0 missing
2. iptables-nft -> Could not fetch rule set generation id: Invalid argument
3. overlay2 on gofer/9p -> EINVAL (vfs fallback causes disk exhaustion)
4. runc init -> mount cgroup / proc: operation not permitted
5. Nested SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_NEW_LISTENER -> EBUSY (device or resource busy)
systrap Seccomp Initialization (pkg/sentry/platform/systrap)
Shared-Memory Futex Syscall Loop (Zero Nested User-Notify FD)
Inner gvx Subsystems (Bypass Outer gVisor Limits)
1. Call seccomp(SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER, SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_NEW_LISTENER)
2. Outer Sentry returns EBUSY (listener slot already occupied)
3. Install plain SECCOMP_RET_TRAP filter + set stubCallMode = _RUN_SYSCALL_LOOP (1)
Container Stub Thread: SIGSYS / Trampoline -> state = THREAD_STATE_PREPARE -> FUTEX_WAIT
Inner gvx Sentry Thread: Polls sysmsg -> Executes Syscall -> FUTEX_WAKE
ext4lite: /var/lib/docker on 1 file + fsuid/fsgid inode_init_owner (PR #70)
netstack: User-space docker0 bridge + veth + iptables-legacy
Inner docker:dind: overlay2 + docker build + docker compose succeed
Shared memory + FUTEX_WAKE
Writes SyscallRegs + FUTEX_WAKE
Switches stub execution mode
Services inner container syscalls
